physics-killer-01.title: Isbeddelka isdhaafka shaqada iyo tamarta farsamada
physics-killer-01.topic: Isbeddelka isdhaafka shaqada iyo tamarta farsamada
physics-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-01.material: Shay ayaa ka bilaabmay nasasho barta A, $50\,\mathrm{m}$ sare, waddo roller-coaster ah oo aan marayn. Dhererka saddexda bar ee waddada waa: barta B $45\,\mathrm{m}$, barta C $30\,\mathrm{m}$, barta D $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada oo isticmaal $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, immisa jeer ay xawaaraha C yahay xawaaraha B, iyo xawaaraha D?
physics-killer-01.thinking.0: Isbeddelka isdhaafka shaqada iyo tamarta farsamada
physics-killer-01.s.s1.prompt: Shay ayaa ka bilaabmay nasasho barta A, $50\,\mathrm{m}$ sare, waddo roller-coaster ah oo aan marayn. Dhererka saddexda bar ee waddada waa: barta B $45\,\mathrm{m}$, barta C $30\,\mathrm{m}$, barta D $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Iska dhaaf iska caabinta hawada oo isticmaal $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, immisa jeer ay xawaaraha C yahay xawaaraha B, iyo xawaaraha D?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: Marka laga bilaabo nasasho, $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ wuxuu bixiyaa $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Sidaas darteed $v_C/v_B=2$ iyo $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Xawaaruhu wuxuu la jaanqaadaa $\sqrt{\Delta h}$, ma aha hoos u dhaca (doodda 1); haddii dhererka D ee $5\,\mathrm{m}$ loo qaato hoos u dhac wuxuu bixiyaa $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (doodda 3); haddii qodobka $\frac12$ la ilaawo wuxuu bixiyaa $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (doodda 4).
physics-killer-01.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
